create_DCGAN_instance: create a DCGAN model instance with custom latent vector dimension and depth parameters
build_generator_network: build a generator network using getNetG with configurable depth and activation settings
build_discriminator_network: build a discriminator network using getNetD with configurable depth and decision layer size
create_optimizer_for_generator: create an Adam optimizer for the generator network with learning rate and beta parameters
create_optimizer_for_discriminator: create an Adam optimizer for the discriminator network with learning rate and beta parameters
